notes.title: Changelog v0.5.9.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Rework Agrestis/Punic Peasant models/textures
[*] Minor bug fix in procedural map generator
[*] Clicking the portrait of the currently selected unit/source moves the camera to the corresponding tile
[*] Increase scale of source models
[*] Add menu button sound effects
[*] Fix crash on cancelled game in menu stage
[*] Minor UI and thumbnail tweaks
[*] Fix bug where unit preview card erroneously showed traits of training unit rather than trained unit
[*] Fix order of starting locations on map Cannae
[*] Silhouettes are now correctly tracked for every player
[*] Rework fog of war (work in progress)
[/list]

[*] Add normal mapping to ground tiles

notes.title: Changelog v0.5.7.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix building thumbnail for Celt-Iberien Barracks, African Warrior Camp
[*] Increase model scale of all units/buidlings slightly
[*] Add graphical fresnel effect
[*] Make hex-grid less pronounced on terrain tiles and tweak terrain tile textures
[*] Tweak default camera field-of-view and direction
[*] Improve ranged attack tracer particle effect
[*] Add setting for number of anisotropic filtering samples
[*] Tweak fog-of-war rendering
[*] Performance and quality improvements for depth-of-field effect
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog v0.5.6.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Add setting option to invert mouse zoom and adjust sensitivity
[*] Change tile circumference display to make use of bezier curves
[*] Fix 'Improved Watch Towers' upgrade erroneously staying in production queue when Turris is upgraded to Castellum
[*] Fix server port settings to allow multiple servers running from the same machine
[*] Add 'Soleae Ferreae' upgrade which increases movement regeneration rate of Equites Romana and Equites Auxilia
[*] Change 'Solid Tree Saddle' to increase melee damage instead of movement speed
[*] 'Berber Horse' now also increases movement range of Numidian Light Cavalry, but base movement range is reduced
[*] New 'Cavalry Charge' upgrade which adds the corresponding skill to the Iberian Heavy Cavalry unit
[*] Cavalry charge allows to deal damage to an enemy unit in a straight line from the caster
[*] Minor improvements to unit orientation logic/rotation animation
[*] Add tooltip with item name on production queue and unit progress bar
[*] Add graphical animation to highlight target tile of a triggered command
[*] Improve particle spawning to be more frame-rate independent
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog v0.5.5.0
notes.content:
- Vigiles Urbani only increases vision range of civilian buildings
- Tweak upkeep values for some buildings
- Temple improvements now also give a unique buff which synergises with their upkeep mechanism
	- Templum Celticus: Upkeep based on territory; Temples have increased territory influence and casting range
	- Templum Romanum: Upkeep based on military buildings; Resource cost of miliatry buildings is reduced by 15%
	- Mausoleum of Dougga: Upkeep based on upgrades completed; Upgrades are 15% cheaper
	- Temple of Baal: Upkeep based on strategic resources; Civilian buildings have increased territory influence
- Tweak vision and territory ranges for some buildings/units
- Add possibility to replace existing unit waypoints rather than appending to them (Ctrl + right click)
- Working steam server list and client authentication
- Basic server list filters and game statistics via Steam
